correctness.rationale: The randomized probability integral transform gives an exact conditional-variance decomposition for the mid-distribution rank. The Gini mean difference is exactly four times its covariance with X. Cauchy--Schwarz gives the bound, and its equality condition is exactly the affine midrank support. Jensen gives the N-atom corollary. The symmetric min-max result follows from exact two-sample identities.

value.rationale: The theorem solves a natural complete optimization problem for a standard dispersion functional under a prescribed discrete probability profile. It quantifies exactly how ties strengthen the classical Gini--variance inequality and uniquely determines the maximizing support geometry. The support-cardinality and symmetric order-statistic consequences give interpretable sharp corollaries.
